pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Intelephense is a PHP language server providing completion, diagnostics, formatting, hover, go to definition and references for any LSP-capable editor. The core features are free; rename, code actions, inlay hints, folding, type hierarchy and a few others need a paid licence key.
Proprietary software under its own EULA: it must be accepted through ACCEPT_LICENSE="intelephense", and it is never mirrored or shipped as a binary package.
